$comment: Deliberate, PERMANENT absences of @stable, read by scripts/reconcile-stable-orphans.ts (#1746).
An entry silences exactly one test's removal, matched on (spec, title) — titles do not drift, line numbers do.

It is verified in BOTH directions (#1084's lesson): if the test carries @stable again, gains a lane tag that already keeps it out of the daily (#1010), is renamed, or turns out never to have carried @stable at all, the declaration is REPORTED as expired instead of being honoured silently — otherwise this check grows the exact silent-expiry problem it exists to close.

A TEMPORARY absence does not belong here. That is what an open issue naming the spec file is for: the reconciler treats any open tracker that names the file as an owner, so a quarantine with a live issue is already accounted for and needs no declaration.
